name.zh-CN: 工程错误诊断与修复建议；语义拓扑角色及来源诊断

description: Map actual provider, intent, feature-rebuild, Countersink/Counterbore, explicit pattern, DatumAxis/Revolve, semantic topology, Fillet/Chamfer, spatial, section, drawing, and export errors to bounded Chinese/English recovery guidance without mutation. including actionable Path continuity, self-intersection, fixed-frame, detached Sweep ADD, and no-intersection Sweep CUT errors with original codes. Translate LOFT_* errors to their original stable code, failed validation stage and one actionable repair. Preserve the EngineeringModel on failure and never substitute another Sketch or partial solid. G7C: reference generated topology only within fixed-binormal planar Line/Arc Sweeps and aligned ruled Lofts; Hole uses caps only, while Fillet/Chamfer uses an explicit intersection of generated face roles. Preserve source Feature, role, and Sketch entity/adjacent ordered-section IDs; never persist OCP Face/Edge ordinals. Re-resolve with tolerances after rebuild and fail closed on zero or multiple matches.
trigger: an actual provider, intent, command, solve, spatial, drawing, or export error occurs
execution_steps: Classify the actual failing stage by code

For SCC-TOOL-010, preserve the raw message and inspect stable part_id, feature_id, slot, parameter identity, and expected type; distinguish stale references, unsupported slots, missing features, and incompatible values only when the actual error supplies that evidence
Check only the relevant current model fact
Offer the smallest legal next step and mark whether confirmation is required
Preserve G2 codes for semantic faces, hole diameter/depth, counterbore/countersink, and pattern count/spacing/axis failures

Preserve TOPOLOGY_REFERENCE_NOT_FOUND, TOPOLOGY_REFERENCE_STALE, AMBIGUOUS_TOPOLOGY_REFERENCE, INVALID_FILLET_RADIUS, FILLET_GEOMETRY_FAILED, INVALID_CHAMFER_DISTANCE, CHAMFER_GEOMETRY_FAILED, and FEATURE_DEPENDENCY_ERROR codes.

Preserve INVALID_DATUM_AXIS, AXIS_REFERENCE_NOT_FOUND, MISSING_PROFILE_REFERENCE, REVOLVE_PROFILE_INVALID, REVOLVE_PROFILE_CROSSES_AXIS, INVALID_REVOLVE_ANGLE, REVOLVE_SELF_INTERSECTION, REVOLVE_GEOMETRY_FAILED, DETACHED_ADD, REVOLVE_CUT_NO_INTERSECTION, and existing body/topology error codes; suggest only the smallest correction supported by the actual model.

Preserve SECTION_REQUEST_INVALID, SECTION_NO_INTERSECTION, SECTION_OPEN_BOUNDARY, SECTION_UNSUPPORTED_CURVE, SECTION_DEGENERATE_LOOP, SECTION_GEOMETRY_FAILED, SECTION_PARAMETRIC_REBUILD_REQUIRED, and SECTION_GEOMETRY_MISSING as distinct causes.
For a section failure, recommend only correcting the explicit principal-axis offset/direction or the reported geometry issue; never fabricate a section loop or fall back to a 2D outline.
For SCC-DRW-009, SCC-DRW-011, or SCC-DRW-014, inspect the exact annotation_id, typed source, current feature suppression state, geometry digest, and view witness.
Explain whether the reference is missing, stale, incompatible with the requested view, unsupported, or disagrees with rebuilt geometry; preserve the original error code.
Offer a concrete user-controlled correction such as selecting a valid view/section or fixing the referenced feature parameter; never auto-rebind to a nearby edge.

Preserve INVALID_COUNTERSINK, COUNTERSINK_NO_INTERSECTION, COUNTERSINK_GEOMETRY_FAILED, PATTERN_UNSUPPORTED_SEED, PATTERN_UNSUPPORTED_PLACEMENT_PLANE, PATTERN_PLANE_MISMATCH, PATTERN_DUPLICATE_PLACEMENT, PATTERN_INVALID_PLACEMENT, and PATTERN_INSTANCE_COLLISION as distinct causes with the actual failing feature and stage.

For PATH_* or SWEEP_* failures, preserve the raw code and explain the actual path, profile-frame, self-intersection, detached-body, or CUT-intersection failure in Chinese and English; suggest only corrections supported by the error evidence.
For missing/incompatible/reversed sections or detached ADD/no-intersection CUT, identify the specific Loft condition and request explicit user correction.
For a generated Sweep/Loft reference, capture the source Feature, semantic face role, Sketch entity identity, or adjacent ordered Loft section pair from the EngineeringModel.
validation_gates: Preserve the original code and message
Explain parameter binding failures in Chinese and English without guessing their cause from SCC-TOOL-010 alone
Do not infer model contents from message text
Never replace a missing or ambiguous semantic face with the first kernel face
Never recommend switching to a different paid model as a CAD geometry recovery
Never repair a missing, stale, or ambiguous semantic edge by choosing the nearest or first kernel edge.
A failed or open section boundary produces no successful drawing/export status; preserve the original section stage and error code.
Do not mark a stale/suppressed feature dimension as resolved.
Do not present nominal EngineeringModel dimensions as measured geometry evidence.
Never auto-create or modify geometry as an annotation recovery.
Do not suggest replacing a failed Countersink with Counterbore or Chamfer unless the user changes the engineering intent.
For an ExplicitPlacement failure, name the actual local placement and declared frame when available; never silently omit the failing instance.
Never hide PATH_* or SWEEP_* error codes, silently change ADD/CUT intent, infer missing dimensions, or mutate the EngineeringModel during recovery.
Any Loft claim requires actual ordered section references and the validated current EngineeringModel rebuild; never infer unsupported topology or hidden section size.
Generated face and edge roles re-resolve against current source geometry with explicit tolerances; zero or multiple matches fail closed, with no persisted OCP ordinals.
failure_policy: Never repeat a failed operation indefinitely
Require confirmation for destructive or intent-changing recovery
On stale, missing, ambiguous, or unsupported topology, preserve the original error code and stop; never retarget by face/edge order.
G7C：在固定 binormal 的平面 Line/Arc Sweep 与 aligned ruled Loft 范围内引用生成拓扑；Hole 仅使用端盖，Fillet/Chamfer 使用明确的生成面交线。所有引用保留来源 Feature、角色及草图实体/相邻有序截面 ID，不保存 OCP Face/Edge 编号；上游重建后按公差重解析，零匹配或多匹配必须失败关闭。
